# Claude Workflow Skills

A collection of public workflow skills for Claude Code to help with repetitive tasks including execution, validation, recovery, and evidence-based termination.

## Core Features
- Execution context: clear branching criteria for when to use and when not to use.
- I/O contracts: clearly defined schemas for required inputs and expected artifacts.
- Action procedures: recovery scenarios performing minimal autonomous repair and rollback upon failure.
- Definition of done: termination verification based on actual physical evidence (file sizes, hashes, etc.) against behavior fixtures.

## Available Skills
- `keepworking-loop`: Locks the goal and executes an autonomous loop of execution, validation, minimal repair, and re-validation.
- `session-to-skill`: Automatically extracts and generalizes validated conversation session logs into reusable Claude Code skills.
- `weekly-report-evidence`: Quantitatively compares original work logs and previous plans to generate an evidence-based weekly report.
